benefits.title: Antioxidant support*
benefits.text: Helps neutralize free radicals and supports the body's response to oxidative stress.*

benefits.title: Studied in exercise
benefits.text: Researchers have studied hydrogen-rich water in the context of exercise, including muscle fatigue and post-workout recovery.

benefits.title: Digestive balance
benefits.text: Early research has looked at hydrogen and the body's natural balance in the digestive tract.

benefits.title: The smallest molecule
benefits.text: Hydrogen is the smallest, lightest molecule in the universe, which is one reason researchers are curious about how it moves through the body.

benefits.title: Softer, fresher taste
benefits.text: Many people describe hydrogen water as tasting softer, fresher and lighter than ordinary water.

fdaDisclaimer: *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

metalReviews.name: Megan R.
metalReviews.text: I keep a tube by the coffee maker and drop one in while the kettle heats up. The raspberry is gentle rather than sugary, and it has quietly become the first thing I drink every morning.
metalReviews.headline: My morning ritual

metalReviews.name: David K.
metalReviews.text: I was skeptical about the price, but the build quality is excellent and the one-button cycle is so simple that I actually use it every day at my desk. The water does taste noticeably softer.
metalReviews.headline: Worth the price

metalReviews.name: Priya S.
metalReviews.text: I like that the unflavored one tastes of nothing but clean, slightly fizzy water. I knocked off a star only because I wish the tubes came in a bigger size for my gym bag.
metalReviews.headline: Gym-bag essential

metalReviews.name: Jordan T.
metalReviews.text: Pineapple after a long run on the beach path is my new little ritual. It feels like a treat without being a soda, and my teenage kids keep stealing them.
metalReviews.headline: A little tropical moment

metalReviews.name: Elaine M.
metalReviews.text: I read a fair bit of the research before buying, and I appreciated that the company talks about it honestly. The ten-minute cycle runs while I get ready, and the bottle comes to work with me.
metalReviews.headline: Ready for the day

metalReviews.name: Camille W.
metalReviews.headline: Simple and refreshing
metalReviews.text: A glass of cold water, one tablet, and a quiet minute before my day begins. I like the clean taste and how easy it is to keep the routine going.

metalReviews.name: Alex L.
metalReviews.headline: Always on my desk
metalReviews.text: The bottle feels beautifully made. I fill it during my first break and let the cycle run while I answer emails. It is a small thing I look forward to every day.

metalReviews.name: Sam B.
metalReviews.headline: A fresh change
metalReviews.text: The raspberry flavor is light and not too sweet. I bring a tube on trips now; my only wish is that I had ordered a second one for home.
